feed.title: VAFT
feed.subtitle: VAFT is an open-source Python framework for tokamak data analysis: an IMAS-compliant data interface built on OMAS, an HSDS remote database of VEST experimental shots, machine mapping into standard IDSs, equilibrium and stability code interfaces (EFIT, CHEASE, GPEC/DCON), profile fitting, and automated Snakemake pipelines.
